coverage.note: This catalog covers all five chapters and keeps optional branches and smaller tasks separate. Press Start lists 93 completed-recap entries, PC Gamer lists 91 slots with 3 names redacted, and DayOne lists 94 entries. Some recap lists include missions that PowerPyx marks optional, so catalog totals are not required-story counts.
coverage.orderNote: Display order follows the broader PowerPyx campaign index, with additional recap names placed beside neighboring missions. Each sourceOrder field retains its publisher’s own sequence; this is not a required play order.
coverage.optionalNote: An explicit optional or side-mission classification sets optional to true even if the mission also appears in a completed recap. Null means required/optional status is not established here. recapSources records named membership independently.
coverage.spoilerNote: Mission and chapter names can reveal story information. Chapter display titles are kept neutral.

discrepancies: The sources count different sets: PowerPyx has 148 campaign-index rows plus separate side quests; PC Gamer has 91 story slots, Press Start 93 recap entries and DayOne 94. This combined catalog has 152 distinct chapter entries.
Press Start includes Thrillbillies and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab in its recap. PowerPyx explicitly marks both optional. Their optional flags are retained alongside recap membership.

Press Start lists Kitter Litter Labs and omits Caught Slipping; PC Gamer lists Caught Slipping but omits the labs. DayOne includes both and also Spin On This. PowerPyx places the two Tyrone lab missions in its side-quest section.
DayOne omits Power Play from its chapter 4 table; PowerPyx, PC Gamer and Press Start list it. The catalog retains it.
PC Gamer redacts three titles; Press Start and DayOne provide unredacted names. No identity was assigned to PC Gamer’s redacted rows by position.
The publishers order some missions differently, including Lab Fees/Just a Scratch, Buck Me/Clean Up After Donnie, and Clear Skies/Day Release. Source positions are preserved.
Car Service/Car Services, Zorrusso/Zorruso, Kitter/Kitty Litter Labs and Sinfreontera/Sinfrontera are source spelling differences. Search aliases preserve them without creating duplicate missions.
Pay Abe’s Fee appears separately in chapters 4 and 5 of PowerPyx’s index. Both entries use chapter-qualified keys.
A missing individual walkthrough stays a source-index link. The late-game That’s Where The Money Is guide was found directly and checked despite not being linked from the index.
